title: retire counts a namer only where the target's name ends, not inside a sibling's
intention: CodeMother's retire counts a file as naming a target only where the target's path or dotted module ends as a whole name, so a sibling whose name has the target's as a prefix (superclaude beside superclaude.py) is not a namer.
why: Measured 2026-11-23: retiring cairn/devices/cc/superclaude from wt-e179 found 18 namers and 47 proofs; every namer named the sibling superclaude.py or a cairn.devices.cc.superclaude* module, never the bash. The door ran 47 proofs twice with no per-proof bound and timed out at 600s and again at 3000s, killed mid-act with the bash moved aside.
traces_to: Law 3 — the namers and callers lists are measurements and the substring match made them wrong; Law 1 — the door re-derived 47 proofs' verdicts for files that never name the target.
how: In namers(), match each needle with a right boundary: re.escape(needle) followed by (?![A-Za-z0-9_\-])(?!\.[A-Za-z0-9_]). A red-first proof builds a scratch repo through cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir and asserts namers() over target tool beside tool.py.

clauses.claim: in a scratch repo holding target pkg/tool beside pkg/tool.py, a file naming only pkg/tool.py and a file naming only pkg.tool_extra are not namers of pkg/tool: namers() returns []
a file naming pkg/tool followed by a space, and a file ending a sentence with pkg/tool. are namers of pkg/tool
the dotted needle obeys the same boundary: a file naming pkg.tool followed by a space is a namer of pkg/tool, and one naming pkg.tooling is not

decisions.text: D1: namers() matches each needle with a compiled right-boundary regex instead of a substring test; needles() is unchanged.
D2: the red-first proof calls namers() over a scratch repo from scratch_dir, one tooth per clause, no runner.

measured.saw: 18 namers / 47 proofs for cairn/devices/cc/superclaude, all naming superclaude.py or cairn.devices.cc.superclaude* modules; retire timed out at 600s and 3000s
measured.how: retire.namers + proofs_for over wt-e179/cairn; bin/cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude (log ~/.akien/temp/cc0-pending-2026-11-23/e179_retire.log)
